host.runtimeLayout: Self-contained PowerShell host; installation prefix omitted. Timing samples are unchanged.

policy.cold: First import and first packet invocation in a fresh process; OS caches are not evicted.
policy.warm: Five remove/import and invocation repetitions in the same process; assemblies remain loaded.
policy.invocation: Exact public packet probe, including assertions and any declared file I/O.

modules.probeScript: $value = Get-PSFConfig | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $value) { throw 'No configuration result.' }; 'ok'
$value = Get-ScriptAnalyzerRule | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $value) { throw 'No analyzer rule.' }; 'ok'

artifactFiles.relativePath: ImportExcel/FAQ/How to Create an Empty Excel File.md
ImportExcel/FAQ/How to Read an Existing Excel File.md
ImportExcel/FAQ/How to Write to an Existing Excel File.md

modules.probeScript: $markdown = '---' + [Environment]::NewLine + 'title: Demo' + [Environment]::NewLine + '---' + [Environment]::NewLine + '# Body'; $value = Get-MarkdownMetadata -Markdown $markdown; if ($null -eq $value) { throw 'No metadata.' }; 'ok'

$root = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('pf-corpus-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null; try { $file = Join-Path $root 'sample.build.ps1'; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($file, "task . { 'ok' }", [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); $value = Invoke-Build -File $file -Task .; if ('ok' -notin @($value)) { throw 'Build task did not run.' } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Force }; 'ok'

$root = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('pf-corpus-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null; try { $source = Join-Path $root 'source.txt'; $zip = Join-Path $root 'archive.zip'; $expanded = Join-Path $root 'expanded'; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($source, 'ok', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); Compress-Archive -LiteralPath $source -DestinationPath $zip; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $expanded; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $expanded 'source.txt'))) { throw 'Archive roundtrip failed.' } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Force }; 'ok'

$job = Start-ThreadJob -ScriptBlock { 6 * 7 }; try { $value = $job | Wait-Job | Receive-Job; if ([int]$value -ne 42) { throw 'Thread job failed.' } } finally { $job | Remove-Job -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; 'ok'
